_comment: MCP server registry vectors. Every implementation of the registry decision (evaluateMcpRegistry in shared-types, the MCP proxy, and the policy snapshot's @mcp_registry record through the JavaScript and bash hook gates) runs these cases and must reach the same code, rule id and reason. toolName is the name a harness hook sees; the server is the part before the first '__' after 'mcp__', the tool the rest. Edit the cases, never one implementation's expectations.

cases.name: a blocked server is refused under allow
cases.reason: MCP server "pastebin" is blocked in this workspace's MCP server registry. An owner or admin can change that on the MCP Servers page.

cases.name: a held server is refused under allow
cases.reason: MCP server "drifted" changed its tools in a way scored high risk, and this workspace holds such a server until it is approved again. It is waiting in the approval queue on the MCP Servers page for an owner or admin.

cases.name: an undecided server passes under allow
a disabled tool is refused on an approved server
cases.reason: Tool "delete_repo" is disabled on MCP server "github" in this workspace's MCP server registry. An owner or admin can re-enable it on the MCP Servers page.

cases.name: a tool disabled on one server is not disabled on another
a tool name after the server may carry a double underscore
cases.reason: Tool "drop__all" is disabled on MCP server "pg-prod" in this workspace's MCP server registry. An owner or admin can re-enable it on the MCP Servers page.

cases.name: a disabled tool name is matched whole
an unapproved server is refused under deny
cases.reason: MCP server "newcomer" is not approved in this workspace's MCP server registry, and the workspace refuses unapproved servers (mcpDefaultPolicy: deny). It is waiting in the approval queue on the MCP Servers page for an owner or admin.

cases.name: an approved server passes under deny
a blocked server is refused as blocked under deny, not as unapproved
cases.reason: MCP server "pastebin" is blocked in this workspace's MCP server registry. An owner or admin can change that on the MCP Servers page.

cases.name: a held server is refused as held under deny
cases.reason: MCP server "drifted" changed its tools in a way scored high risk, and this workspace holds such a server until it is approved again. It is waiting in the approval queue on the MCP Servers page for an owner or admin.

cases.name: a disabled tool is refused under deny on an approved server
cases.reason: Tool "delete_repo" is disabled on MCP server "github" in this workspace's MCP server registry. An owner or admin can re-enable it on the MCP Servers page.

cases.name: server names match exactly, not case-insensitively
cases.reason: MCP server "GitHub" is not approved in this workspace's MCP server registry, and the workspace refuses unapproved servers (mcpDefaultPolicy: deny). It is waiting in the approval queue on the MCP Servers page for an owner or admin.

cases.name: deny with nothing approved refuses every server
cases.reason: MCP server "github" is not approved in this workspace's MCP server registry, and the workspace refuses unapproved servers (mcpDefaultPolicy: deny). It is waiting in the approval queue on the MCP Servers page for an owner or admin.

cases.name: a server name is not a prefix match
cases.reason: MCP server "github2" is not approved in this workspace's MCP server registry, and the workspace refuses unapproved servers (mcpDefaultPolicy: deny). It is waiting in the approval queue on the MCP Servers page for an owner or admin.
